// CASE prelude_serial_loop expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await validate(item);
  }
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE prelude_serial_loop_any_name expect=fire
Future<List<Row>> syncRows(
  List<Row> rows,
  int width,
  Future<Row> Function(Row) upload,
) async {
  final results = <Row>[];
  for (final row in rows) {
    await db.lock(row.id);
  }
  for (var offset = 0; offset < rows.length; offset += width) {
    final group = rows.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(upload)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE prelude_while_loop expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  var page = 0;
  while (page < 3) {
    await warm(page);
    page++;
  }
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE prelude_sync_loop expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks2<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    check(item);
  }
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE plain_loop_control expect=fire
Future<void> control(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await validate(item);
  }
}
